backlog_role_actors_principal_consistent.name: backlog_role_actors_principal_consistent
backlog_role_actors_principal_consistent.value:
(
        ("backlog_role_actors"."actor_type" = 'user' and "backlog_role_actors"."user_id" is not null and "backlog_role_actors"."group_id" is null)
        or ("backlog_role_actors"."actor_type" = 'group' and "backlog_role_actors"."group_id" is not null and "backlog_role_actors"."user_id" is null)
      )

permission_grants_scope_consistent.name: permission_grants_scope_consistent
permission_grants_scope_consistent.value:
(
        ("permission_grants"."scope" = 'global' and "permission_grants"."permission_scheme_id" is null and "permission_grants"."principal_type" in ('user', 'group'))
        or ("permission_grants"."scope" = 'backlog' and "permission_grants"."permission_scheme_id" is not null)
      )

permission_grants_principal_consistent.name: permission_grants_principal_consistent
permission_grants_principal_consistent.value:
(
        ("permission_grants"."principal_type" = 'user' and "permission_grants"."user_id" is not null and "permission_grants"."group_id" is null and "permission_grants"."project_role_id" is null)
        or ("permission_grants"."principal_type" = 'group' and "permission_grants"."group_id" is not null and "permission_grants"."user_id" is null and "permission_grants"."project_role_id" is null)
        or ("permission_grants"."principal_type" = 'project_role' and "permission_grants"."project_role_id" is not null and "permission_grants"."user_id" is null and "permission_grants"."group_id" is null)
        or ("permission_grants"."principal_type" = 'authenticated_user' and "permission_grants"."user_id" is null and "permission_grants"."group_id" is null and "permission_grants"."project_role_id" is null)
      )

release_publication_items_disposition_co.name: release_publication_items_disposition_consistent
release_publication_items_disposition_co.value:
(
        ("release_publication_items"."disposition" = 'retained' and "release_publication_items"."destination_release_id" is null and "release_publication_items"."destination_release_name" is null)
        or ("release_publication_items"."disposition" = 'moved' and "release_publication_items"."destination_release_name" is not null)
      )

release_publications_incomplete_disposit.name: release_publications_incomplete_disposition_consistent
release_publications_incomplete_disposit.value:
(
        ("release_publications"."incomplete_disposition" = 'keep' and "release_publications"."destination_release_id" is null and "release_publications"."destination_release_name" is null)
        or ("release_publications"."incomplete_disposition" = 'move' and "release_publications"."destination_release_name" is not null)
      )

releases_dates_order.name: releases_dates_order
releases_dates_order.value: "releases"."start_date" is null or "releases"."release_date" is null or "releases"."release_date" >= "releases"."start_date"

sprint_items_outcome_consistent.name: sprint_items_outcome_consistent
sprint_items_outcome_consistent.value:
(
        ("sprint_items"."left_at" is null and "sprint_items"."outcome" is null and "sprint_items"."destination_sprint_id" is null)
        or ("sprint_items"."left_at" is not null and "sprint_items"."outcome" is not null)
      )

sprint_items_destination_consistent.name: sprint_items_destination_consistent
sprint_items_destination_consistent.value:
(
        ("sprint_items"."outcome" = 'carried_to_sprint' and "sprint_items"."destination_sprint_id" is not null)
        or ("sprint_items"."outcome" is distinct from 'carried_to_sprint' and "sprint_items"."destination_sprint_id" is null)
      )

sprints_planned_dates_order.name: sprints_planned_dates_order
sprints_planned_dates_order.value: "sprints"."planned_end_at" is null or ("sprints"."planned_start_at" is not null and "sprints"."planned_end_at" > "sprints"."planned_start_at")

sprints_state_dates_consistent.name: sprints_state_dates_consistent
sprints_state_dates_consistent.value:
(
        ("sprints"."state" = 'planned' and "sprints"."started_at" is null and "sprints"."completed_at" is null)
        or ("sprints"."state" = 'active' and "sprints"."started_at" is not null and "sprints"."completed_at" is null)
        or ("sprints"."state" = 'completed' and "sprints"."started_at" is not null and "sprints"."completed_at" is not null and "sprints"."completed_at" >= "sprints"."started_at")
      )
